context.projectOverview: Sprint 7: make every graph-consuming surface work end-to-end through the RESOLVED backend, add a backend-status readout, AND close the accumulated cr-graph correctness follow-ups so cr-graph genuinely works command-to-command. The cr-graph adapter is now feature-complete (Sprints 5+6: read + query). Sprints 1-6 wired resolveGraphBackend into construction; this sprint proves the surfaces EXERCISE it for cr-graph and fixes the last gaps.
accumulatedFollowupsToFoldIn: HIGH — reviewContext narrow bypass (from Sprint 5 eval): GraphClient.reviewContext() (client.ts ~91-94) uses runRaw() (identity cast, client.ts ~216-218) which BYPASSES the backend's reviewContextPlan.narrow. For cr-graph, get_review_context_tool returns a JSON OBJECT, so reviewContext() returns the raw object mistyped as GraphResult<string> instead of the narrowed string. FIX: make GraphClient.reviewContext() apply the backend's narrow (call runWithSandbox with narrow like overview() does, or give runRaw an optional narrow param defaulting to identity). This is authorized in-scope for Sprint 7 (command parity / make cr-graph work). Keep tokensave reviewContext byte-identical (its raw is already a string, so narrow=identity-equivalent there — verify the tokensave reviewContextPlan.narrow is a passthrough).

MEDIUM — codeReviewGraphPath not threaded through the transport (from Sprint 4 doc): mcp-client.ts spawnAndHandshake resolves the spawned binary as `cfg.tokensavePath ?? processSpec.binary`, so config.graph.codeReviewGraphPath is NOT honored for the serve subprocess (only processSpec.binary is). FIX: thread the per-backend binary override so codeReviewGraphPath is used when backend=code-review-graph (e.g. resolve the binary at the construction site from the backend + config, and pass it in, rather than hardcoding cfg.tokensavePath). Keep tokensave byte-identical.

LOW/doc — cr-graph `update` is git-diff-base driven, not positional-path like tokensave `sync <paths>` (from Sprint 4). If not cleanly reconcilable within the CliMap interface here, leave the existing behavior + the bober: ceiling comment and defer to a Sprint-8 documented follow-up. Do NOT force a risky change.

principles: TypeScript strict, ESM .js imports, import type, no any, no sync fs, conventional commits. Never main. Baseline entering this sprint: 5076 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failures. Commit BEFORE final response. Tokensave path MUST stay byte-identical (its existing onboard/impact/graph/reviewContext tests must pass unchanged). Do NOT rework onboard's search()-based data strategy (nonGoal).
